type: Technical System Architecture Diagram (Dark Engineering Style)
goal: Create an architecture overview diagram for a multi-tenant AI customer service SaaS production line technical review, emphasizing public internet entry, application VPC, data and message planes, and the trust boundary delineation with external APIs.

canvas.background: deep slate #0F172A with subtle 1px grid lines #1E293B at 32px spacing

title_strip.title: AuroraDesk AI Customer Service Platform · Production Architecture
title_strip.subtitle: v2.3 · ap-southeast-1 · 2026-Q2
title_strip.position: top-left, large mono font (JetBrains Mono / SF Mono), light gray text

palette.use_for: API Gateway, Load Balancing, CDN, BFF

regions.rule: Surround nodes belonging to the same 'deployment unit' with a large dashed box, with a region label above the box

items.label: EKS Workloads · Business and orchestration plane

node_style.size: auto-fit text + 24px horizontal padding, ~ 140px wide × 56px tall typical
node_style.label: label text in JetBrains Mono / SF Mono 12pt, color = role color (lighter shade) for readability on dark bg
node_style.icon: small icon in top-left corner of node (optional, generic geometric glyph for the role — circle for service, cylinder for DB, hex for queue)

sync_call.style: solid line 1.5px in slate #64748B, with small filled triangle arrowhead at the target end

async_event.style: dashed line 1.5px in slate #64748B, with hollow triangle arrowhead

data_flow_label.rule: optional small labels on edges (e.g., 'POST /orders' / 'order.created event'), using mono font 9pt, background blending with the canvas

edges.rule_routing: Try to make lines orthogonal (horizontal/vertical); if diagonal lines are necessary, keep them ≤ 30°; don't let edges cross nodes

legend.content: color → role mapping (8 swatches), and edge style → meaning (sync solid vs async dashed)
legend.style: small panel with semi-transparent background, mono font 10pt

must_keep: Colors coded by role, do not code by technical brand (e.g., PostgreSQL uses violet because it is data, not because PG official blue)
Nodes have consistent rounded corners and size baseline
Monospaced font (mono) throughout the entire image
Edges do not pass through nodes, labels do not overlap with edges
The color of the dashed box matches the meaning of the area
Legend must be shown (even if simplified)
avoid: Rainbow Color / High Saturation Neon Color (All Colors Muted Except Cyan)
Use emoji as node icon (with minimalist geometric glyph)
Directly paste the technical logo (unless it's a trademark comparison说明)
The same color represents both 'safety' and 'business'
Over 15 nodes (please split into multiple sub-images)
Claims this image is editable / exportable as SVG (it is a bitmap)
Use fancy fonts / handwritten styles (destroys engineering feel)
